hero.subtitle: A TypeScript-first scene graph library that decouples your graphics logic from the rendering engine. Build once, render anywhere.

features.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to build stunning 2D and 3D graphics applications, with the flexibility to choose your rendering engine.
features.engineAgnosticDesc: One scene graph, multiple renderers. Decouple your graphics logic from the rendering engine and switch freely between backends.
features.typescriptFirstDesc: Complete type definitions, intelligent autocompletion, and full type safety. Written in TypeScript from the ground up.
features.sceneGraphDesc: Hierarchical node-based architecture with attachable components: geometry, materials, cameras, transforms, and more.
features.threeRendererDesc: Full WebGL 3D rendering powered by Three.js. Support for cameras, lighting, materials, and glTF model loading.
features.svgRendererDesc: Lightweight 2D vector graphics, perfect for generative art, data visualization, and interactive diagrams.
features.serializationDesc: Save and load complete scenes in JSON format. Perfect for editors, persistence, and sharing scene configurations.
features.canvas2dRendererDesc: Lightweight browser-native 2D rendering with zero external dependencies. Perfect for UI overlays, HUDs, and 2D games with hardware-accelerated graphics.
features.gltfLoaderDesc: Import complex 3D models from Blender, Maya, or any glTF-compatible tool with full support for geometry, PBR materials, and animations.
features.csgOperationsDesc: Constructive Solid Geometry for creating complex shapes. Union, subtract, and intersect geometries to build intricate 3D models programmatically.
features.lightSystemDesc: Complete lighting with Ambient, Directional, Point, and Spot lights. Full shadow casting support for realistic 3D scene illumination.

renderers.sectionSubtitle: Write your scene logic once. Render with Three.js for immersive 3D WebGL, SVG for scalable vector graphics, or Canvas2D for lightweight browser-native 2D.
renderers.threeDesc: Full 3D rendering powered by Three.js and WebGL. Support for perspective and orthographic cameras, PBR materials, glTF model loading, and real-time interaction events.
renderers.svgDesc: Lightweight vector graphics rendering. Perfect for generative art, data visualization, interactive diagrams, and resolution-independent graphics with CSS styling support.
renderers.swapNote: Same scene graph — just swap the renderer
renderers.canvas2dDesc: Zero-dependency browser-native 2D rendering. Perfect for UI overlays, HUDs, procedural patterns, and 2D games. Full transform hierarchy and hardware-accelerated Canvas API.

capabilities.sectionSubtitle: Oroya Animate goes beyond rendering. Animate, interact, and generate — all from a unified, engine-agnostic API.

animation.title: Animation System
animation.description: Keyframe-based animations with AnimationClip, AnimationMixer, and multiple interpolation modes. Animate any property — position, rotation, scale, color — with precise timing control.

interactivity.title: Interactivity
interactivity.description: Built-in event system with raycasting for 3D and DOM event delegation for SVG. Click, hover, and drag objects in your scene with a unified API across renderers.

generative.title: Generative Art
generative.description: Create algorithmic art with the SvJs engine. Perlin noise, gaussian distributions, and SVG primitives for building organic, procedural visuals directly in the browser.

csg.title: Boolean Operations (CSG)
csg.description: Create complex shapes by combining simple geometries. Union merges shapes, Subtract carves holes, and Intersect keeps only overlapping regions — all powered by Constructive Solid Geometry.

lighting.title: Lighting System
lighting.description: Illuminate your 3D scenes with four light types: Ambient for uniform glow, Directional for sunlight, Point for light bulbs, and Spot for flashlights. Full shadow casting support.

code.sectionSubtitle: Create scenes with an intuitive, TypeScript-first API. Add nodes, attach components, and render with your engine of choice — all in a few lines of code.
code.highlight1: Hierarchical scene graph with node-based architecture
code.highlight3: Swap renderers without changing scene logic
code.highlight4: Built-in primitives: box, sphere, cylinder, plane

getStarted.sectionSubtitle: Install the core package and your preferred renderer. You'll be rendering your first scene in under a minute.

about.title: About the Project
about.subtitle: Oroya Animate is an open-source graphics library created and maintained by Josué Oroya, a software engineer focused on graphics systems, developer tooling, and programming education.
about.paragraph1: The project started as an experiment to separate scene logic from rendering engines, making it possible to reuse the same scene graph across different rendering backends like Three.js and SVG.
about.paragraph2: Oroya Animate continues to evolve as a playground for graphics architecture, generative art, and interactive visualization tooling for the web.
about.creatorBio: Software engineer based in Japan, passionate about graphics systems, open-source tooling, and making creative coding accessible to everyone.
